svg.aria-label: Trust boundaries. The operator sets budgets, seals holdouts and approves memory promotion. Red and blue sides each have two agents and a private memory neither side can read across. Trusted code in the middle, which no agent can modify, holds the execution harness, the sandbox with the target agent and synthetic tools, the gateway, the independent verifier and the budget ledger. Red attacks enter the sandbox only through an untrusted surface; blue's guard is frozen for the run; verified development runs feed Dreaming; holdout results never feed back.
